Start date: 1304-02-25  
Subtract 30 weeks = 210 days.  
Subtract 2 more days = 212 days total.  

1304 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
From Feb 25 back 212 days:  
Feb 25 → Jan 26 (30 days back) → Dec 27, 1303 (another 31 days = 61 total) → keep going back.  

212 days back from 1304-02-25:  
Days in Jan 1304: 31, so Feb 25 → Jan 25 is 31 days, Jan 25 → Dec 25, 1303 is 31 days (62 total),  
then Nov 25 (30 days → 92 total), Oct 25 (31 → 123), Sep 25 (30 → 153), Aug 25 (31 → 184),  
Jul 25 (31 → 215) — too far. We need 212, so 3 days earlier than Jul 25: Jul 22, 1303.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1303-07-22
